forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8880'
+title: 'ViewValueLayoutTests.theStyleHasNoPaddingByte fails with EditorKit 0cbc4834: EditorStyle.previewHeight adds 7 padding bytes'
+---
+Found while implementing ^aqfjne7, after `swift package update` resolved EditorKit main 0cbc4834.
+
+EK 9495fb06 (^jn3qmmy, PreviewField) added a stored `previewHeight: CGFloat` to `EditorStyle`, after `density` (1 byte). The root unit test `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Infrastructure/ViewValueLayoutTests.swift` `theStyleHasNoPaddingByte` now fails:
+
+```
+EditorStyle: size 136, offsets [0, 40, 72, 96, 112, 120], field sizes [40, 32, 24, 16, 8, 1]
+uncoveredByteCount → 15
+```
+
+15 = 8 bytes of the unlisted `previewHeight` (offset 128) + 7 real padding bytes after `density` (121..<128). `ToolCallBody` holds `EditorStyle` as a value, so SwiftUI's byte compare (^4zzf5cw / ^fzn2beh) can see unequal bytes for equal styles.
+
+Fix is in EK (not AVK): order `EditorStyle`'s stored fields so no padding byte remains (e.g. `previewHeight` before `symbolWeight`/`density`), send to editorkit. Then add `\.previewHeight` to the AVK test's key paths.
+
+Main checkout resolves EK bcce50e4 (before 9495fb06), so it does not see this yet.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift test --filter ViewValueLayoutTests` passes against current EK main.
\ No newline at end of file
